title: Only the head is held; every other node is reached by following next
caption: The list 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → None. There is no index: reaching the k-th node costs k − 1 hops.

frames.text: All you are given is head, a pointer to the first node. Each node holds a value and one next pointer; the last next is None.
To read the 3rd value you start at head and follow next twice. curr = head.next.next lands on 3.
One more hop reaches the tail 4, whose next is None. Walking the whole list is O(n); there is no shortcut.
